fieldNotes.location: 2330 Port of Tacoma Rd, Tacoma WA 98421. SalSon's Tacoma market is operated by TriPak Inc — one of the seven companies merged into SalSon in Aug 2024 (the dossier's 'TriPack Logistics'); TriPak was earlier a TTSI division. Confirmed via loadmatch ('SalSon Logistics (Tri Pak, Inc. div. of TTSI) / Tacoma, WA') and Commtrex/LoopNet listings for 2330 Port of Tacoma Rd. The building is a ~94,590 SF transload warehouse built 1966, rail-served, with a ~3-acre paved fenced yard per the LoopNet lease listing.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or gate seen across the truck approach in Street View — the transload warehouse fronts a public port-industrial street and trucks pull straight onto the yard apron. Some lease copy describes the yard as 'fenced'; no controlled checkpoint structure is visible. Left FALSE, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE — a rail spur / classification yard runs directly along the NE side of the warehouse; TriPak advertises 80+ rail car spots and is a rail transload specialist (bulk grains, aggregates, food-grade, lumber, steel).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Street View (west face) shows containers and a row of dock doors with intermodal boxes backed in; overhead imagery supports a 10-25 band — estimate ~22.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Open paved yard holds drayage chassis, tractors and parked containers/trailers — a 25-50 drop area.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main long transload warehouse plus a smaller attached/adjacent annex structure.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Port of Tacoma industrial core — Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~6.5 acres for the warehouse footprint plus its yard, estimated from the perimeter box; the LoopNet listing cites ~3 acres of paved yard alone (the leasable parcel may be smaller than the audited operational footprint).
